{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Commission on the Conduct of the War''' was a bureaucratic body of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Commission once compiled a report entitled ''[[Effectiveness of Standard Escort and Patrol Tactics Against Enemy Interdiction]]'' in response to successful [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] attacks on Imperial supply convoys. The Empire eventually found the perfect solution to this problem in the form of the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]].
